name: deltasignal-atlas-7
description: SEC-grounded crypto public issuer intelligence with compact daily monitoring, evidence drilldowns, Azure-native audit status, and x402 paid access.

interface.shortDescription: SEC-grounded ATLAS-7 stress, alpha, fundamentals, daily monitoring, evidence drilldowns, and audit status.
interface.longDescription: DeltaSignal ATLAS-7 gives Codex an MCP-first tool surface for SEC-grounded issuer intelligence on crypto public companies. It exposes composite presets for morning briefs, company reports, pressure boards, alpha sweeps, and quick ticker checks, plus granular readiness, covenant stress, peer ranking, alpha, fundamentals, risk distribution, compact daily monitoring, paginated daily evidence drilldowns, and Azure-native 215-issuer regression audit status. Public MCP initialize and tools/list are free for discovery; public tools/call remains x402-protected unless a free-tier grant applies. Public Builder metadata uses usage credits; credit packs are not implemented yet.
defaultPrompt: Use deltasignal_morning_brief for a DeltaSignal daily scan.
Use deltasignal_company_report with ticker RIOT for a full issuer report.
Use deltasignal_pressure_board, deltasignal_alpha_sweep, or deltasignal_quick_ticker_check for focused preset workflows.
Use deltasignal_daily_changes for compact Daily Monitoring.
Use deltasignal_daily_change_evidence with ticker ARKB for paginated raw issuer proof.
Use deltasignal_atlas7_audit_status when the user asks whether the full 215-issuer audit is healthy.
